description: Availability schedule cells (teardown-persona5 PR-P3, shared with teardown-yakuza Y6): where someone or something is, as a function of weekday pattern x day part x weather x season x story flag. Cells compose the condition vocabulary of event-flag.schema.json (condition ids are strings owned by that schema) rather than forking it. CONTENT FENCE: this schema lands with ZERO canon rows — schedule content for named cast is authored per settlement in story order (owner slot). An availability cell with no row means 'not scheduled', never 'invented'.

conditions.description: Event-flag condition ids (vocabulary owned by event-flag.schema.json); all must hold for the cell to apply.

season.description: Season id as derived by src/lib/worldClock.ts; omit for all seasons.

storyFlag.description: Story flag id that must be set; omit for unconditional.

subjectId.description: Who or what this cell places (NPC, service, encounter class).

weather.description: Weather state id; omit for all weathers.

weekdayPattern.description: Weekday pattern key as derived by src/lib/worldClock.ts (week shape is config, never canonised in code).
